results.name: more_switches_at_near_equal_span
results.description: Among pairs whose tally spans differ by at most 1, the rate of choosing the sequence with more H/T switches; observed above null means the model under-predicts a preference for alternation.

results.name: late_minus_early_streak_avoidance
results.description: Rate of choosing the sequence with the shorter longest run in the second half of trials minus the first half; positive observed above null means streak avoidance strengthens over the session, which a static model cannot produce.

results.name: participant_streak_avoidance_variance
results.description: Variance across participants of their rate of choosing the sequence with the shorter longest run (pairs differing in longest run); observed above null means individual differences in streak aversion exceed what the personal span ideal produces.

results.name: consensus_extremity_equal_span
results.description: Among pairs with equal tally span, the mean absolute deviation from 0.5 of the per-pair choice rate (order-normalised); observed above null means people agree on these pairs while the model predicts near-indifference.

results.name: shorter_longest_run_at_equal_span
results.description: Among pairs whose tally spans are equal, the rate of choosing the sequence with the shorter longest run; observed above null means people penalise streaks beyond what the span captures.

results.name: balanced_count_at_equal_span
results.description: Among pairs whose tally spans are equal, the rate of choosing the sequence with the smaller heads-tails imbalance (final count closer to even); observed above null means the model under-weights final count balance.

results.name: heads_preference_equal_span
results.description: Among pairs with equal tally span but different heads counts, the rate of choosing the sequence with more heads; observed away from null means an H/T asymmetry the symmetric span model misses.

results.name: more_distinct_triplets_at_equal_span
results.description: Among pairs with equal tally span, the rate of choosing the sequence with more distinct length-3 substrings (pattern variety); observed above null means people value local variety the span model ignores.
